title: [tool.inwards]
description: Configuration of Inwards, the architecture linter for Python, in pyproject.toml. The schema checks structure, types, enums and syntax; the parser also checks relations between entries (unique names, context ownership) and required-version.
markdownDescription:
Configuration of Inwards, the architecture linter for Python, in pyproject.toml. The schema checks structure, types, enums and syntax; the parser also checks relations between entries (unique names, context ownership) and required-version.

[Reference](https://sircypkowskyy.github.io/inwards/guides/configuration/#configuration-reference)

root.description: Directory, relative to pyproject.toml, that module names are computed from.
root.markdownDescription:
Directory, relative to pyproject.toml, that module names are computed from.

[Reference](https://sircypkowskyy.github.io/inwards/guides/configuration/#root)

layers.description: The layers, innermost first. A module may import its own layer and any layer listed before it.
layers.markdownDescription:
The layers, innermost first. A module may import its own layer and any layer listed before it.

[Reference](https://sircypkowskyy.github.io/inwards/guides/configuration/#layers)

required-version.description: The oldest Inwards allowed to check this project, as "MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH". An older binary fails with a config error.
required-version.markdownDescription:
The oldest Inwards allowed to check this project, as "MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH". An older binary fails with a config error.

[Reference](https://sircypkowskyy.github.io/inwards/guides/configuration/#required-version)

ignore.description: Module names left out of the INW006 unassigned-package warning, matched as whole segments anywhere in a module name.
ignore.markdownDescription:
Module names left out of the INW006 unassigned-package warning, matched as whole segments anywhere in a module name.

[Reference](https://sircypkowskyy.github.io/inwards/guides/configuration/#ignore)

generated.description: Modules a build step writes, which INW010 treats as existing: dotted names whose segments may use * and ?. A list, even an empty one, replaces the default.
generated.markdownDescription:
Modules a build step writes, which INW010 treats as existing: dotted names whose segments may use * and ?. A list, even an empty one, replaces the default.

[Reference](https://sircypkowskyy.github.io/inwards/guides/configuration/#generated)

escalate-after.description: How many attempts at the same violation before the hooks stop blocking and tell the agent to ask the user.
escalate-after.markdownDescription:
How many attempts at the same violation before the hooks stop blocking and tell the agent to ask the user.

[Reference](https://sircypkowskyy.github.io/inwards/guides/configuration/#escalate-after)

stop-gate.description: What the Claude Code Stop gate checks: "changed" (the files the session changed) or "project" (the whole project against its baseline).
stop-gate.markdownDescription:
What the Claude Code Stop gate checks: "changed" (the files the session changed) or "project" (the whole project against its baseline).

[Reference](https://sircypkowskyy.github.io/inwards/guides/configuration/#stop-gate)

cycles.description: Which import cycles INW004 reports: between modules, between bounded contexts, both, or none ([]).
cycles.markdownDescription:
Which import cycles INW004 reports: between modules, between bounded contexts, both, or none ([]).

[Reference](https://sircypkowskyy.github.io/inwards/guides/configuration/#cycles)

shape.description: Package shapes: which members a package may, must and must not hold (INW007, INW008). The first matching entry wins.
shape.markdownDescription:
Package shapes: which members a package may, must and must not hold (INW007, INW008). The first matching entry wins.

[Reference](https://sircypkowskyy.github.io/inwards/guides/configuration/#shape)

names.description: Where a member name may appear (INW007).
names.markdownDescription:
Where a member name may appear (INW007).

[Reference](https://sircypkowskyy.github.io/inwards/guides/configuration/#shape)

agent-suppressions.description: Whether the Claude Code hooks honour an inline suppression the agent added: "deny" treats it as absent, "allow" honours it.
agent-suppressions.markdownDescription:
Whether the Claude Code hooks honour an inline suppression the agent added: "deny" treats it as absent, "allow" honours it.

[Reference](https://sircypkowskyy.github.io/inwards/guides/configuration/#agent-suppressions)

contexts.description: Bounded contexts or slices: what each owns, which of its modules others may import, and which contexts it may depend on (INW002, INW003).
contexts.markdownDescription:
Bounded contexts or slices: what each owns, which of its modules others may import, and which contexts it may depend on (INW002, INW003).

[Reference](https://sircypkowskyy.github.io/inwards/guides/configuration/#contexts)

dottedName.description: A dotted Python name such as shop.orders, with no wildcards.

selector.description: A package selector: a.b (exact), a.* (one level) or a.** (any depth).

memberPattern.description: A member pattern: a name or fnmatch glob (*, ?, [seq], [!seq]), optionally ending in .py or /. Inwards also rejects a reversed range such as [z-a].

ruleCode.description: A rule code this Inwards knows.

name.description: The layer's name, unique among layers.
name.markdownDescription:
The layer's name, unique among layers.

[Reference](https://sircypkowskyy.github.io/inwards/guides/configuration/#layers)

modules.description: Module prefixes that belong to the layer: shop.domain owns shop.domain.order.
modules.markdownDescription:
Module prefixes that belong to the layer: shop.domain owns shop.domain.order.

[Reference](https://sircypkowskyy.github.io/inwards/guides/configuration/#layers)

allow-libraries.description: Libraries the layer may import; when set, any other third-party library is denied (INW005).
allow-libraries.markdownDescription:
Libraries the layer may import; when set, any other third-party library is denied (INW005).

[Reference](https://sircypkowskyy.github.io/inwards/guides/configuration/#layers)

deny-libraries.description: Libraries the layer may not import, stdlib included (INW005).
deny-libraries.markdownDescription:
Libraries the layer may not import, stdlib included (INW005).

[Reference](https://sircypkowskyy.github.io/inwards/guides/configuration/#layers)

extend-deny-libraries.description: Libraries added to the layer's deny list or to the innermost layer's default list (INW005).
extend-deny-libraries.markdownDescription:
Libraries added to the layer's deny list or to the innermost layer's default list (INW005).

[Reference](https://sircypkowskyy.github.io/inwards/guides/configuration/#layers)

packages.description: Package selectors this shape applies to.
packages.markdownDescription:
Package selectors this shape applies to.

[Reference](https://sircypkowskyy.github.io/inwards/guides/configuration/#shape)

allow.description: Members the package may hold; anything else is extra.
allow.markdownDescription:
Members the package may hold; anything else is extra.

[Reference](https://sircypkowskyy.github.io/inwards/guides/configuration/#shape)

forbid.description: Members the package must not hold.
forbid.markdownDescription:
Members the package must not hold.

[Reference](https://sircypkowskyy.github.io/inwards/guides/configuration/#shape)

extra.description: How an extra member is reported: "error" or "warning".
extra.markdownDescription:
How an extra member is reported: "error" or "warning".

[Reference](https://sircypkowskyy.github.io/inwards/guides/configuration/#shape)

pattern.description: One member pattern, such as test_*.
pattern.markdownDescription:
One member pattern, such as test_*.

[Reference](https://sircypkowskyy.github.io/inwards/guides/configuration/#shape)

only-in.description: Package selectors where members matching the pattern may appear.
only-in.markdownDescription:
Package selectors where members matching the pattern may appear.

[Reference](https://sircypkowskyy.github.io/inwards/guides/configuration/#shape)

rules.description: Which rules report and how loudly. ignore wins over select; INW000 can't be ignored or re-levelled.
rules.markdownDescription:
Which rules report and how loudly. ignore wins over select; INW000 can't be ignored or re-levelled.

[Reference](https://sircypkowskyy.github.io/inwards/guides/configuration/#rules)

select.description: Only these rules report. Must list at least one code.
select.markdownDescription:
Only these rules report. Must list at least one code.

[Reference](https://sircypkowskyy.github.io/inwards/guides/configuration/#rules)

ignore.description: These rules don't report. INW000 can't be listed.
ignore.markdownDescription:
These rules don't report. INW000 can't be listed.

[Reference](https://sircypkowskyy.github.io/inwards/guides/configuration/#rules)

severity.description: Per-rule severity, such as { INW006 = "warning" }. INW000 can't be listed.
severity.markdownDescription:
Per-rule severity, such as { INW006 = "warning" }. INW000 can't be listed.

[Reference](https://sircypkowskyy.github.io/inwards/guides/configuration/#rules)

name.description: The context's name: non-blank, case-sensitive, unique among contexts.
name.markdownDescription:
The context's name: non-blank, case-sensitive, unique among contexts.

[Reference](https://sircypkowskyy.github.io/inwards/guides/configuration/#contexts)

modules.description: Literal module prefixes the context owns, with their descendants. The longest matching prefix decides a module's one owning context.
modules.markdownDescription:
Literal module prefixes the context owns, with their descendants. The longest matching prefix decides a module's one owning context.

[Reference](https://sircypkowskyy.github.io/inwards/guides/configuration/#contexts)

public.description: Prefixes of this context's own modules that contexts depending on it may import. Absolute names, not relative to the context.
public.markdownDescription:
Prefixes of this context's own modules that contexts depending on it may import. Absolute names, not relative to the context.

[Reference](https://sircypkowskyy.github.io/inwards/guides/configuration/#contexts)

depends-on.description: Contexts this one may import from directly: not transitive, not reverse.
depends-on.markdownDescription:
Contexts this one may import from directly: not transitive, not reverse.
